abstract: Primary choriocarcinoma of the stomach is an extremely rare and highly malignant tumor. A 68-year-old Japanese man was admitted to our department with symptoms of epigastric pain, abdominal fullness, and dizziness. Primary gastric choriocarcinoma with regional lymph node metastases was diagnosed preoperatively by the detection of elevated serum levels of a tumor marker, radiography, and immunohistochemical staining of biopsy specimens. The patient underwent total gastrectomy and jejunal reconstruction (Roux-en-Y method), followed by chemotherapy. Histological examination of the resected stomach revealed typical choriocarcinoma accompanied by common adenocarcinomatous elements. After postoperative chemotherapy the patient survived for 4 years and 6 months, and died with no evidence of recurrence of carcinoma. This is the first known patient with primary gastric choriocarcinoma to have survived for such a long period without recurrent elevation of the serum level of human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), which was a useful marker when reevaluating the patient.
abstract_ja: 原発性胃絨毛癌は極めて稀で悪性度の高い腫瘍である。68歳の日本人男性が、心窩部痛、腹部膨満感、めまいを主訴に当科を受診した。血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇、X線検査、生検組織の免疫組織化学染色により、領域リンパ節転移を伴う原発性胃絨毛癌と術前に診断された。患者は胃全摘術とRoux-en-Y法による空腸再建を受け、その後化学療法を施行された。切除胃の組織学的検査では、一般的な腺癌成分を伴う典型的な絨毛癌が認められた。術後化学療法の後、患者は4年6か月生存し、癌の再発を認めることなく死亡した。原発性胃絨毛癌で、血清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇を伴わずにこれほど長期間生存した初の症例である。hCGは本患者の経過を再評価するうえで有用なマーカーであった。
